bundle.shortDescription: Offline AI character creator and chat rooms
bundle.longDescription: Create characters with images, GIFs, video or VRM models, import character cards, and chat one-on-one, in groups or in Discord-style channels. Runs local models out of the box; cloud APIs are optional.
